packageRules.description: npm's default 'replace' strategy skips an update whose version already satisfies the declared range, so a caret range would only ever see majors — bump the range and the lock file together, the same way the typo3-extension preset does for composer
typo3/cms-core 14.3 requires doctrine/dbal ~4.4.4, so a newer minor cannot be installed until core widens its constraint
